abilities.name: The Needle
abilities.grants: Slash, block, dash-stab, bounce, grappling hook, combo with other abilities
abilities.note: Hornet's main weapon in Silksong; versatile offensive and mobility tool

abilities.name: Tools
abilities.grants: Throwing weapon or defensive aid use without costing Silk
abilities.note: Special items equipped on a Crest with limited slots; changed at a Bench similar to Charms

abilities.name: Crests
abilities.note: Changed when sitting on a Bench; analogous to the Charm system

abilities.name: Dream Nail
abilities.grants: Access to Elder Hu's spirit fight; collects Essence
abilities.note: Must be acquired before Elder Hu's spirit can be fought at his memorial

abilities.name: Shade Cloak
abilities.note: Highly recommended (though not required) for dodging Elder Hu's ring attacks

bosses.name: Elder Hu
bosses.note: Spirit of a travelling sage fought at his memorial above City of Tears gates. Attacks: Ring Slam (row of rings slammed down with safe gaps), Ring Curtain (pairs of rings from arena edges toward centre), Teleport. Drops 100 Essence on defeat. Requires Dream Nail to access.

objectives.name: Acquire the Dream Nail
objectives.hopDescription: Obtain the Dream Nail to unlock the ability to fight Elder Hu's spirit at his memorial

objectives.name: Fight Elder Hu's spirit at his memorial
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to Elder Hu's memorial above the gates of the City of Tears and use the Dream Nail to initiate the fight
objectives.note: Dodge Ring Slam and Ring Curtain attacks; Shade Cloak highly recommended

objectives.name: Collect Essence from Elder Hu
objectives.hopDescription: Use the Dream Nail to collect 100 Essence after Elder Hu's spirit shatters

connectors.description: Elder Hu's journey took him from the Mantis Village (where he died) to a memorial erected above the City of Tears gates
connectors.note: Narrative/lore connection; Elder Hu's memorial is above the City of Tears gates
